items.text: Request Staff in Newfoundland and Labrador

blocks.html:
Finding the right people for the right roles is one of the biggest challenges for organizations today.  Many businesses face staffing shortages, skill gaps, and time constraints that slow down growth. 

On the other side, qualified professionals are looking for opportunities but struggle to connect with the right employers.  This disconnect creates frustration, wasted resources, and missed opportunities.

Goodwill Staffing and Recruitment bridges that gap. We provide businesses in Newfoundland and Labrador with reliable staffing solutions while helping skilled professionals secure meaningful work.

Our approach is matching the right talent with the right employers, quickly and efficiently. 

If you are a facility looking for the most talented healthcare professionals, or a professional looking for the best job opportunties in your field of expertise, you’re in the right place. Get in touch with us now or request staffing.

Why Health Facilities Choose Us?

Healthcare in Newfoundland and Labrador is unique. Hence, facilities must balance growing demand with limited staffing pools. Especially in rural communities and long-term care homes.

Goodwill provides staffing solutions built for this reality.

We understand the province’s healthcare system, its regional challenges, and the urgency facilities face when shifts go unfilled.

When you work with us, here’s what you gain:

  • Qualified professionals ready to step in – nurses, PSWs, and allied health staff with verified experience.
  • Flexible coverage – temporary, contract, and long-term placements.
  • Reliability – staff who arrive on time, trained, and ready to deliver safe care.
  • Streamlined process – fast response to last-minute needs.

blocks.text: Supporting Long-Term Care in Newfoundland and Labrador

blocks.html:
Long-term care homes in Newfoundland and Labrador face constant pressure to keep shifts covered while maintaining quality care. When staff are short, resident safety and comfort are at risk. That’s where we step in.

We supply qualified nurses. We also provide personal support workers and allied health professionals. They bring experience in dementia care. They understand palliative support. They handle mobility assistance with skill. Every professional is vetted. Each one is credentialed. They are ready to contribute from day one.

Our focus is on consistency. We help homes avoid last-minute gaps, reduce strain on permanent teams, and keep care standards high.

Do you need healthcare staff or healthcare jobs? Talk to us now.

Our Newfoundland and Labrador staffing services provide:

  • Registered Nurses (RNs) – delivering clinical expertise in hospitals, clinics, and community health.
  • Licensed Practical Nurses (LPNs) – offering vital support in long-term care, rehabilitation, and acute care.
  • Personal Support Workers (PSWs) – assisting with daily living, mobility, and personal comfort.

Every professional we place is screened, credentialed, and matched carefully to the environment where they’ll be most effective.

blocks.text: Allied Health Staffing in Newfoundland and Labrador

blocks.html:
Beyond nursing, Newfoundland and Labrador healthcare facilities often need specialized allied health professionals. Goodwill supplies qualified staff in roles such as:

  • Respiratory therapy
  • Medical laboratory services
  • Medical imaging
  • Physiotherapy and occupational therapy
  • Pharmacy support

Our goal is to keep diagnostic, therapeutic, and support services running without disruption.

blocks.text: Serving All Regions of Newfoundland and Labrador

blocks.html:
Goodwill Staffing and Recruitment provides healthcare staffing across Newfoundland and Labrador, including:

St. John’s – hospitals, clinics, and large facilities facing high demand.

Smaller urban centres such as Corner Brook, Gander, and Labrador City.

Rural and remote communities where staffing shortages are most severe.

Wherever your facility is located, we help ensure staffing challenges never compromise patient care.

blocks.text: Why Work With Goodwill in Newfoundland and Labrador

blocks.html:
Facilities choose us because we provide stability. Our process is built around:

  • Thorough vetting – every candidate is qualified, experienced, and reference-checked.
  • Speed and flexibility – we respond quickly when you need coverage.
  • Local knowledge – we understand Newfoundland and Labrador’s healthcare system and staffing requirements.
  • Commitment to care – we supply professionals who share the values of compassion, safety, and respect.

Healthcare leaders across Newfoundland and Labrador face the same challenge. And this includes filling critical shifts without sacrificing care quality.

Goodwill Staffing and Recruitment is here to help. We specialize in connecting facilities with professionals who can step in, adapt, and deliver the care patients and residents depend on.

items.question: Are your staff licensed to work in Newfoundland and Labrador
items.answer: Yes. All staff are licensed with NSCN or their appropriate regulatory body and meet the province’s practice standards.

items.question: Can you provide support to long-term care and hospitals?
items.answer: Absolutely. We support Alberta Health facilities, LTC homes, private clinics, and group homes across the province.

items.question: Do you offer mental health or addictions-trained staff?
items.answer: Yes. We have a roster of professionals with training in trauma-informed care, harm reduction, and behavioral support for mental health and addictions programs.

items.question: Do you support placements outside major cities?
items.answer: Yes. We staff healthcare professionals in rural and coastal regions, including St. John’s, Corner Brook, Gander, and Labrador City.
